overview: Ad platforms only learn from what they can see. We install the pixel or tag for each ad account you use, on your own store, and pass the key shopper events: page views, product views, add to cart, checkout and purchase. We test each one with the platform's own checking tool and fix duplicates, so you can build audiences and judge results with clean data.

faq: Which platforms can you set up?
Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat and Microsoft Advertising. Choose the ones you actually run or plan to run soon. Unused pixels only slow your pages down.
Do you need access to my ad accounts?
Yes, as a standard user or partner you invite in your own account. We never ask for passwords. We only need permission to read the pixel and set up events, not to spend money.
Will pixels slow my store down?
A little, since each one loads code. We install them the lightest way available and, with Standard and above, avoid duplicates. For many tags, ask about Tag Management so they load together.
Does this include running the ads?
No. This sets up the tracking that ads depend on. Campaign setup and management are separate services. We follow each platform's rules on data use, consent and what events may be sent.
